requirements: resolve_leverage MUST apply ordered first-match rules so that inverse-with-multiplier is tested before plain inverse and before leverage: '인버스2X'/'-2X'/'곱버스' yield -2, '인버스'/'-1X' yield -1, '레버리지'/'2X'/'2배' yield +2, otherwise +1.

resolve_leverage MUST return Confidence.LOW when mutually contradictory tokens are present in one name, and callers MUST exclude LOW-confidence instruments from any leverage-conditional policy (fail-closed).

load_sponsor_brand_map MUST read configs/sponsor_brands.yaml and return a flat mapping from ETF brand prefix (first token of ISU_NM) to asset-manager issuer name; every brand listed under asset_managers MUST be present.
resolve_issuer MUST return the issuer for a mapped brand and the literal string 'UNKNOWN' for any unmapped brand; it MUST NOT guess or default to a sponsor.
InstrumentMaster.build MUST derive first_seen and last_seen from actual presence in the price panel, because the KRX Open API exposes no ETF base-info endpoint.
InstrumentMaster.build MUST set left_censored True when first_seen equals the panel start date, and the history filter MUST treat left-censored instruments as satisfying warmup.

InstrumentMaster.build MUST set index_key from normalize_index_key(IDX_IND_NM) and leverage_family_key from resolve_family_key(index_key, family_overrides); leverage_family_key MUST NOT be derived by stripping tokens from ISU_NM.
Explicit entries in the overrides mapping MUST take precedence over every name-derived attribute and MUST set Confidence.HIGH.
resolve_family_key MUST return index_key unchanged when no override maps it; when an override maps index_key to family_id, resolve_family_key MUST return family_id.

LeverageFamilyIndex.build MUST group instruments sharing the same leverage_family_key into one LeverageFamily with one LeverageFamilyMember per ticker; members MUST be sorted by leverage_multiple then ticker for determinism.
normalize_index_key MUST apply NFKC normalisation, case folding and whitespace collapsing; null or empty index names MUST map to a distinct sentinel key.
Taxonomy.classify MUST be ordered first-match-wins and MUST be a pure function of (name, index_name).
Taxonomy rules MUST live in configs/taxonomy.yaml, never in Python literals.
TournamentRules MUST distinguish null (no constraint) from unknown (undetermined). Parsing the YAML token 'unknown' MUST produce the UNKNOWN sentinel.
TournamentRules.scenarios_for MUST return both candidate values for an UNKNOWN boolean field and the configured grid for an UNKNOWN numeric field.
TournamentRules.horizon_sessions MUST compute the tournament length from TradingCalendar.session_count(start_date, end_date); the literal 40 MUST NOT appear anywhere.
UniverseFilters.for_mode MUST set issuer_whitelist to None for STRUCTURAL and to the sponsor asset-manager tuple for DEPLOYMENT when universe_config requests sponsor_asset_managers.

UniverseFilters.for_mode MUST attach manifest from configs/universe_manifest.yaml when present; a non-null manifest MUST restrict eligibility to those isu_cd values in addition to any issuer whitelist.
UniverseFilters.required_adv MUST equal capital * max_position_weight / max_order_to_adv.
PointInTimeUniverse.get MUST apply filters strictly in the order existence, price, history, sponsor, liquidity, eligibility and MUST record a per-stage drop count in UniverseSnapshot.dropped.
The sponsor filter MUST be skipped entirely when filters.mode is STRUCTURAL; dropped['sponsor'] MUST be 0 in that case.

The existence filter MUST require a panel row on that exact date; the price filter MUST require is_tradable True with a positive close; the history filter MUST require calendar.session_count(first_seen, day) >= warmup_sessions unless left_censored.
When issuer_whitelist is not None, instruments whose issuer resolved to UNKNOWN MUST be excluded at the sponsor stage (fail-closed).
When manifest is not None, instruments whose ticker is absent from manifest MUST be excluded at the sponsor stage before liquidity.
ADV MUST be a trailing mean over adv_window sessions from trading_value using only sessions with is_tradable True, ignoring non-tradable sessions rather than treating them as zero.
The rolling ADV panel MUST be computed once at construction time; recomputing ADV inside get() is forbidden.
PointInTimeUniverse.get MUST use only panel rows with date <= day.
UniverseSnapshot MUST include the UniverseMode used for the query.
cmd_universe MUST accept --date, --mode {structural,deployment} defaulting to deployment, and --max-order-to-adv, and MUST log admitted count, mode, and per-stage drop counts with the [DATA] tag.

scenarios.expected_behavior: resolve_leverage returns -2 for 'KODEX 200선물인버스2X' and 'KIWOOM 미국달러선물인버스2X'; -1 for 'ACE 인버스' and 'HANARO 200선물인버스'; +2 for 'ACE 레버리지', 'TIGER 미국필라델피아반도체레버리지(합성)' and 'ACE 삼성전자단일종목레버리지'; +1 for 'KODEX 200' and '1Q 200액티브'. The inverse-2X cases MUST NOT resolve to +2.

InstrumentMaster.build over a panel where ticker A appears on all sessions, B appears only from the second session, and C disappears after the second session yields first_seen/last_seen matching those observations; A is left_censored True while B is False. load_sponsor_brand_map maps 'KODEX' to '삼성자산운용' and resolve_issuer('KODEX 200', brand_map) returns '삼성자산운용' while resolve_issuer('WON 200', brand_map) returns 'UNKNOWN'. leverage_family_key for an instrument with IDX_IND_NM '코스피 200' equals normalize_index_key('코스피 200') and is not derived from ISU_NM.

normalize_index_key('코스피 200') == normalize_index_key(' 코스피  200 ') and both differ from normalize_index_key('코스피 200 TR'); normalize_index_key(None) returns a sentinel not equal to any real index key.
Taxonomy classify is ordered first-match-wins; coverage() over 9 matched and 1 unmatched returns 0.9.

TournamentRules.from_yaml on configs/tournament.yaml yields start_date 2026-09-21, end_date 2026-11-13, initial_capital 1_000_000_000, sponsor_etf_only True, leverage_allowed is UNKNOWN; horizon_sessions(TradingCalendar()) == 36; scenarios_for('leverage_allowed') == (True, False).

UniverseFilters(capital=1_000_000_000, max_position_weight=1.0, max_order_to_adv=0.01).required_adv() == 1e11. On a synthetic panel, get() with max_order_to_adv 0.01 admits exactly instruments whose ADV >= 1e11.

get() drop counts attribute each exclusion to exactly one stage in order existence, price, history, sponsor, liquidity, eligibility; sums with len(tickers) equal instruments present on that date. issuer UNKNOWN drops at sponsor when issuer_whitelist is set. mode STRUCTURAL leaves dropped['sponsor'] == 0.
PointInTimeUniverse truncated to dates <= d yields the same get(d) tickers as the full panel; is_tradable False rows are excluded from ADV mean.

LeverageFamilyIndex.build groups two instruments sharing leverage_family_key 'kospi200' with leverage multiples +1 and +2 into one LeverageFamily with two members; an instrument with a different leverage_family_key forms a separate family. resolve_family_key with override mapping 'kospi200_futures' -> 'kospi200' merges keys.

On a panel containing one KODEX instrument (issuer 삼성자산운용) and one WON instrument (issuer UNKNOWN), deployment get() admits only KODEX while structural get() admits both (assuming other filters pass). UniverseFilters.for_mode(DEPLOYMENT, ...) sets issuer_whitelist to the ten sponsor asset managers.
'universe' is a key of SUBCOMMANDS; main(['universe', '--date', '2026-08-27', '--mode', 'deployment', '--max-order-to-adv', '0.05']) returns 0 and logs [DATA] with mode and per-stage drop counts.
